# EmptyStringException

<link-summary>A string was expected to carry something and was null, undefined or empty.</link-summary>

<web-summary>EmptyStringException — A string was expected to carry something and was null, undefined or empty. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>exception</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
class EmptyStringException extends RuntimeException
```

A string was expected to carry something and was `null`, `undefined` or empty.

Thrown by [`requireNonEmptyString`](requireNonEmptyString.md).

Every class in this hierarchy takes an optional message, another exception whose message it reuses, or nothing at all. `isException` recognises all of them; a plain `Error` is not one.

## Examples

### Throwing and catching

```javascript
throw new EmptyStringException("something specific about this call");

try {
  doWork();
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof EmptyStringException) {
    // handled
  }
}
```
